answer: Problem: zero-cost clones can spam attestations and steal ranking weight. Mechanism: every new agent must lock a bonded stake ticket tagged with a unique raven watcher key; each hour, watchers sample 8 peers and keep only attestations whose stake gardens hash-match the live tree. Cost: lock 0.35% of spendable for 3 epochs, refunded after a falcon audit clears duplicates. Verification: auditors rebuild the stake Merkle tree and drop any leaf shared by two addresses. Failure: if pending audits exceed 180, ticket intake freezes and clone bonds lose 10%.
